blocker.summary: r472 understood and fixed the multi-modification resolution ordering bug r471 left open: draw_pinned()'s pixel_candidates array tried the depth-hint-dropped fallback candidates before the exact-depth-hint+ParamGen candidate, backwards from the intent already stated in its own comment. Reordered. Installed r471's merged 320-entry pinned shader registry (native/fixtures/pinned-shader-registry.v1.bin, previously never actually committed despite a dedicated .gitignore negation since r255 -- committed cleanly this cycle, not a backlog bulk-commit) after fixing two tests the merge broke (stale exact-count assertions, and a second real divergence in the legacy translate_ucode() path's own modification==0-first resolution rule, not previously mirrored by the test). Native ctest 11/11, no regression. The campaign's actual goal (visible non-black content) is STILL not reached: the native product's own --probe-entry harness is unchanged and never drives the long deploy-confirmation input sequence (hangar/map/deploy confirms) that r470/r471 needed on the oracle side to reach world=1 and capture the new shader coverage -- so nothing in the current native probe run actually exercises the 49 newly-registered variants. Named for r473: extend the native product's --probe-entry harness (or an equivalent input-replay mechanism) to drive the same confirmation sequence, then re-probe. Still open, non-blocking: the PinnedShaderRuntime backlog commit decision (r433/r434/r438/r454-r472, now including the candidate-ordering fix and test updates).
